research_question: When the model, adapter, semantic content, cases, seeds, sampling, and gate are fixed, do target-language labels and/or a line-oriented preverbal-message serialization improve RightBrain semantic realization over the current mixed-language JSON payload?

motivation.v30_result: Both V10 and base-only omitted required semantics on more than 75% of raw candidates, so adapter choice alone did not explain the shared failure.
motivation.current_payload: The user payload contains Japanese dynamic meaning inside English-keyed JSON and English fixed instructions.
motivation.theory_boundary: Preverbal message is an operational software label for the already-decided meaning passed from planning to formulation. This experiment does not establish biological equivalence to human speech production.

external_evidence.title: A Fair Comparison without Translationese: English vs. Target-language Instructions for Multilingual LLMs
external_evidence.relevance: Instruction-language effects are task-dependent; target-language instructions are not universally better, so language must be isolated experimentally.

external_evidence.title: Does Prompt Formatting Have Any Impact on LLM Performance?
external_evidence.relevance: Prompt format can materially change model performance and no format is universally optimal, motivating a crossed format factor.

external_evidence.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
external_evidence.relevance: The active base model is multilingual and instruction-tuned, but the report does not establish an optimal Japanese payload representation.

japanese_json.definition: Same canonical leaves and hierarchy; structural labels and finite instruction vocabulary are rendered in Japanese.

mixed_lines.definition: Same canonical leaves rendered as deterministic path-value lines with current mixed labels.

japanese_lines.definition: Same canonical leaves rendered as deterministic path-value lines with Japanese labels.

controlled_variables: maximum output tokens and output character limit
representation_integrity: Every condition must be generated from the exact current control JSON payload.
The ordered dynamic semantic fingerprint must match across all four conditions.
Every scalar leaf path in the canonical payload must have one represented counterpart; empty containers must remain explicit.
No condition may add examples, answer text, case-specific advice, or new memory content.

outcomes.primary_success: At least one of three initial candidates passes the unchanged strict gate.

statistics.multiple_comparison_control: Holm correction over the first four isolated-factor contrasts
statistics.uncertainty: case-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence interval with 10000 samples
statistics.candidate_level_boundary: Candidate-level rates are descriptive because three candidates from one seed-case are not independent.

advance_gate.best_condition_selection: Highest strict case coverage, then lower semantic omission, then lower hard-surface failure, then lower prompt-token count.

research_boundary: These are previously observed V29 development cases. A passing condition can authorize only a fresh source-separated holdout. It cannot promote runtime, prove human likeness, prove a cognitive theory, or justify retraining.
